critical_code_review_comments: ProgressionBadges.jsx L41 — CSS grid `repeat(auto-fill, minmax(min(104px,100%), 1fr))` is the correct pattern; at 320px it yields 2 columns × 127px, at 1920 it yields 8 columns × 106px, matching main-agent's own sweep. `min(104px, 100%)` guarantees no horizontal overflow on ultra-narrow viewports.

ProgressCard.jsx L36-68 — TaskRow uses `flex flex-wrap items-start` + `flex-1 min-w-[180px] break-words` + `shrink-0` on the action chip. Verified: at 320px width (row 262w), text takes 235w, chip wraps to next line at left=0. This is the correct wrap behavior described in the change.

ProgressCard.jsx L173-208 — Progress bar (`<Bar>`) is now correctly rendered OUTSIDE the `{expanded ? ... }` gate (L208 vs L209), so collapsed state still shows header + count + bar + chevron per spec. aria-expanded on header button (L183) is bound to `expanded` state and correctly reflects toggle.

CelebrationModal.jsx L37 — inline style `maxHeight:'85dvh'` overrides the .or-modal-card CSS max-height `calc(100vh - 24px - env(safe-area-inset-top) - env(safe-area-inset-bottom))` because inline styles beat stylesheet rules unless !important. Both values give roughly the same behavior on modern browsers, but consider adding `!important` to the CSS rule OR removing the inline style for consistency with the rest of `.or-modal-card` sizing. Not a bug — both paths yield within-viewport rendering. Consider consolidating.

Leaderboards.jsx — 20 category-chip elements render as flex-wrap OR horizontal-scroll (didn't visually inspect); 0 horizontal document overflow at 320 which is the KPI. Row cells (avatar/username/rep) collapse cleanly at 320 within a 296px row width.

Layout.jsx global paddingBottom `calc(110px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom))` — verified: at every viewport the view-leaderboards-button's bounding rect.bottom is well above the bottom-nav's top (e.g. 320: btnBottom=318 navTop=502, 1920: btnBottom=617 navTop=1009). Sufficient clearance.
